description: This file defines a PHP class 'sysinfo' that gathers system information on Windows NT systems using WMI via COM objects. It includes methods for retrieving OS details, hardware info, network stats, memory, filesystems, and system uptime.
external_files: WMI COM interface (implied, not explicitly included)

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class to retrieve Windows NT system information using WMI via COM objects.

methods.name: sysinfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the WMI COM object.

methods.name: vhostname
methods.description: Returns the server name or virtual host name.

methods.name: ip_addr
methods.description: Returns the IP address of the server.

methods.name: kernel
methods.description: Retrieves the OS version and service pack info.

methods.name: uptime
methods.description: Calculates system uptime based on LastBootUpTime.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Returns the number of terminal sessions.

methods.name: loadavg
methods.description: Returns CPU load percentages for each processor.

methods.name: cpu_info
methods.description: Provides CPU details such as model, cache, and clock speeds.

methods.name: network
methods.description: Provides network interface error and discard statistics.

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Gathers RAM and swap memory info.

methods.name: filesystems
methods.description: Lists disk partitions, sizes, and types.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns a static icon filename for the OS.
